identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Study of CAR-T Technique in the Treatment of Recurrent and Refractory Hematopoietic and Lymphatic Tumor

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Main research objective: To evaluate the safety of autologous CAR-T cell injection in the treatment of recurrent and refractory hematopoietic and lymphoid tissue tumors. Secondary research objective: To investigate the efficacy and cytodynamic characteristics of autologous CAR-T cell injection in the treatment of recurrent and refractory hematopoietic and lymphoid tissue tumors

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety: Incidence and severity of adverse events
primaryOutcomes.description: The incidence and severity of adverse events and adverse reactions from infusion to withdrawal or before the safety follow-up period
